operations.restart: Queued jobs are reconstructed; processing jobs become failed with stage 'Server stopped'.
operations.cancellation: Queued jobs only; active processing cannot be canceled cooperatively.
operations.retry: Reprocess creates a new linked job rather than mutating the terminal job.
operations.errors: A failed job stores error text and stage in SQLite.
operations.result: Paths, analysis values, candidates, cues, and quality fields are stored on the job row.

operations.restart: State is lost; files/catalog writes completed before restart remain.
operations.cancellation: Cooperative checks before/during download and before the final library write.
operations.retry: No direct retry endpoint; submit a new import request.
operations.errors: Terminal state contains sanitized error text; cancellation reports 'Canceled by user'.
operations.result: Completed state exposes filename, optional processing job ID, and a private file path.

operations.restart: State and staging work are not recovered; completed WAV/catalog writes remain.
operations.retry: No direct retry endpoint; upload again. Individual file failures are included in results.
operations.errors: Batch-level error text or per-file failed result entries.
operations.result: Counts and per-file imported, duplicate, or failed outcomes.

operations.restart: State is lost and matching must be submitted again.
operations.retry: No direct retry endpoint; upload the CSV again.
operations.errors: A failed match stores error text in transient state.
operations.result: Matched source candidates are held in transient state.

operations.restart: Processing state is rewritten as failed and retryable by BackgroundTaskRegistry.
operations.retry: Failed track records can be submitted to the retry endpoint, which creates a new batch.
operations.errors: Batch error text plus persisted import-failure records and an import report.
operations.result: Counts and report paths persist; completed file/catalog writes survive restart.

operations.restart: Lifecycle state and retry inputs are lost; completed file/catalog writes remain.
operations.retry: Any terminal batch may create a linked retry; recorded failed item IDs narrow the retry when available.
operations.errors: Structured per-item errors plus a terminal error for unexpected worker failure.
operations.receipt: operation_receipt for processing and every terminal outcome
operations.result: Counters, errors, worker-specific results, and durable write locations.

operations.restart: Read-only findings are lost and the scan must be run again.
operations.errors: Unreadable tags are findings; an unexpected worker exception currently has no terminal failure translation.
operations.receipt: operation_receipt while processing and on successful completion
operations.result: Read-only findings and counts; repairs are separate synchronous operations with durable receipts.

operations.restart: Lifecycle state is lost; quality values already written to SQLite remain.
operations.retry: Start a new scan; unavailable/invalid tracks are counted as failures within a completed scan.
operations.errors: Up to 30 per-track errors are retained in transient state; unexpected worker failure is not translated.
operations.result: Per-track quality records persist in SQLite and the batch returns an aggregate summary.

operations.restart: Pending, processing, or canceling jobs become failed and retryable; requests remain available for retry.
operations.cancellation: Cooperative checkpoints before retrieval, during provider planning, and before publication; a newer plan supersedes active work.
operations.retry: Failed or canceled jobs create a linked retry using the persisted request.
operations.errors: Safe terminal error text; no partial set is applied on failure or cancellation.
operations.receipt: planning result contains evaluation and observability, not operation_receipt
operations.result: Validated plan, warnings, candidate scarcity, evaluation, provider outcome, and timings.

operations.restart: Processing becomes failed with an interruption error; the saved plan may be started again.
operations.cancellation: Cooperative checks during copy and verification; catalog relinking is not an interrupt checkpoint.
operations.retry: Planned, failed, or canceled state may be started again; rollback is available after a completed move/relink with backup.
operations.errors: Terminal error text and a structured errors list persist in the relocation manifest.
operations.result: Transfer counts, updated catalog paths, database backup path, and original-retained flag persist.
